# Network Conference - Debating Communities and Networks

> A series of academic conferences exploring digital communities, social networks, and online identity across Web 2.0 platforms, hosted by Curtin University and Open Universities Australia.

The Network Conference is an ongoing academic event dedicated to examining how communities form and interact online through social media, gaming, and virtual spaces. The conference series features presentations and discussions on topics ranging from Web 2.0 platforms like Facebook and Instagram to digital surveillance, youth identity, and indigenous community engagement online.

## Key Topics

- Social Networks
- Online Communities
- Web 2.0
- Social Media
- Digital Identity
- Facebook
- Instagram
- YouTube
- Online Games
- Virtual Communities
- Curtin University
- Open Universities Australia
- Indigenous Communities
- Digital Surveillance
- Youth Identity

## Conference Editions

- [Debating Communities and Networks XIII (2022)](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2022/): 2022 Debating Communities and Networks Conference hosted by Curtin University and Open Universities Australia
- [Debating Communities and Networks X (2019)](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2019Curtin): 2019 Debating Communities and Networks X Conference at Curtin University
- [Debating Communities and Networks IX (2018 Bentley)](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2018Bentley): 2018 Debating Communities and Networks IX Conference at Curtin University Bentley
- [Debating Communities and Social Networks (2018 OUA)](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2018OUA/): 2018 OUA Debating Communities and Networks Conference official site

## 2018 Bentley Conference Streams

- [March 2018 - Web 2.0 and Online Communities](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2018Bentley/2018/03): March 2018 conference stream on Web 2.0 and online communities
- [May 2018 - Social Media and Youth Identity](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2018Bentley/2018/05): May 2018 stream on Instagram, Facebook, and youth online identity

## 2018 OUA Conference Streams

- [March 2018 - Web 2.0 and Virtual Communities](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2018OUA/2018/03): OUA March 2018 conference stream on Web 2.0 and virtual communities
- [April 2018 - Gaming and Social Media Communities](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2018OUA/2018/04): OUA April 2018 stream on gaming and social media communities
- [May 2018 - Digital Platforms and Surveillance](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2018OUA/2018/05): OUA May 2018 stream on Facebook, YouTube, and digital surveillance

## 2019 Conference Content

- [Social Media Identity and Self-Presentation](https://networkconference.netstudies.org/2019Curtin/type/quote): 2019 conference content on social media identity and self-presentation
